title: Eight Days of Hope opens its Pontotoc headquarters for a free Dec. 5 Christmas party
excerpt: The Dec. 5 party at 142 Kings Highway offers equipment rides, lunch and cookie decorating. A second event with the same name is downtown on Dec. 10.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc families can climb aboard equipment, decorate cookies and stay for lunch at Eight Days of Hope on Saturday, Dec. 5. The free Christmas party runs from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. at the organization’s national headquarters, 142 Kings Highway in Pontotoc. Families can come without registering.

The program also includes a touch-a-truck activity, bounce houses, crafts and a hot chocolate bar. Eight Days of Hope describes the invitation to Northeast Mississippi families as a thank-you to its neighbors.

Two Pontotoc events use the name Merry Little Christmas Party. The Dec. 5 gathering is the one on Kings Highway. The Pontotoc County Chamber calendar lists the other for Thursday, Dec. 10, from 5 to 7 p.m. downtown.

The Saturday party is part of Eight Days of Hope’s fourth annual Weekend of Hope. Its ticketed gala takes place two nights earlier, Thursday, Dec. 3, at 6 p.m. at Huntington Bank Arena in Tupelo. The organizer lists the west tower doors for gala guests.
